scripts.build: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run build -w @fuyue/ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/travel-ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/memory-cloud && npm run build -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run build -w @fuyue/relay && npm run build -w @fuyue/web && npm run build -w @fuyue/showcase
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/web && npm run build -w @fuyue/showcase && node scripts/merge-pages.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run build -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run dev -w @fuyue/web
scripts.dev:showcase: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/ui && npm run dev -w @fuyue/showcase
scripts.dev:phone: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run dev -w @fuyue/web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4184 --strictPort
scripts.dev:relay: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/relay && npm run start -w @fuyue/relay
scripts.doctor:relay: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/relay && node --env-file-if-exists=apps/relay/.env scripts/doctor-relay.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run build -w @fuyue/ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/travel-ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/memory-cloud && npm run build -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run build -w @fuyue/relay && npm run build -w @fuyue/showcase && npm run test -w @fuyue/core && npm run test -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run test -w @fuyue/ui && npm run test -w @fuyue/travel-ui && npm run test -w @fuyue/memory-cloud && npm run test -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run test -w @fuyue/relay && npm run test -w @fuyue/web && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run check:privacy
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/core && npm run build -w @fuyue/core && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run build -w @fuyue/toybox && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/ui && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/travel-ui && npm run build -w @fuyue/travel-ui && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/memory-cloud && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run build -w @fuyue/kaomoji-drawer && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/relay && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/web && npm run typecheck -w @fuyue/showcase
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
